name: stack

training_provenance.recipe: bandori.sweep_harness.prepare_fit + fit_jointnet; exported by dist/tools/export_stack_package.py; validated by runs/sweep_stack_20261019/train_post12_30_test325.py
training_provenance.scope: 30 supervised events: 12 strictly-post-rule (311, 314-324) + 18 most recent older events; 312/313 are pre-rule starts and are not part of the post-rule block
training_provenance.reference_pool: 319 events through 324 (fold-train 315 + 321-324); analog/daily features use this pool, supervised labels only the 30
training_provenance.features: finished pca layout (1168 columns); selected 600 = explicit block cols 16..111 + rule block cols 664..1167 (block_cols({'rule','expl'}))
training_provenance.architecture: JointNet hidden 8, seed 1729, 240 epochs, learning_rate 0.01, weight_decay 0.003, bias_penalty 3, weights mean/scale/a/b/v/d
training_provenance.fit_cutoff_basis: start of event 325 = 1790647200; labels of 321-324 verified available before 325; 325/326 excluded from fitting

limitations: Single held-out validation: event 325 scored 4.50% (external 24 fresh-input points) and 7.55% (standing 164 focal-tier rows) MAPE; descriptive, not an independent fresh test
Events 325/326 are excluded from fitting (fit_cutoff = start of event 325)
Hyperparameters (hidden 8, seed 1729, 240 epochs, gain 1.0) are inherited from the frozen sweep recipe and were not re-selected for this exact 30-event scope
Supervised labels include closing-tracker proxies; RMS-like errors contain systematic bias and carry no coverage guarantee
Reference/analog pool stops at event 324; forecasts for events inside that pool are rejected
Eight actual post-rule events (311, 314-320); each held event is removed from fold training and all references
LOO can train on later pre-321 events: event transfer estimate, not a chronological backtest
Model-family design used earlier inspected experiments; this is approximate calibration, not an independent coverage test
Events 321-326 excluded from residual calibration; 321-324 remain in the production network fit
RMS includes systematic bias; no normality or 68% coverage guarantee; proxy closing labels are not official finals
Same-tier neighboring horizon bins are pooled until four event clusters; no cross-tier borrowing
No sigma for unlabeled tiers or observations older than one hour; no event-type-specific or outage calibration
Production has more post-rule training events; sigma is not automatically reduced
Eight events provide weak support for very long events; extrapolation is explicitly flagged
Residual checkpoints are 08:00/20:00/21:00 CN; other issue times use the same hours-remaining buckets
